TOPIC: Pet rules

TOPIC_DESCRIPTION: Situation: During the viewing, the decision may depend on whether the landlord accepts pets. You have a small dog, so this is the key moment to raise it clearly, understand the rules, and learn what information the agent needs.
Learner: Tenant. Partner: Agent.
Not in this scene: basic viewing logistics, general rent details, submitting the full application or arranging contract signing.

About the learner, in their own words: Renting a flat in Berlin, viewing with the agent, I have a small dog

SURVIVAL_SET:
must_say:
1. ask whether something is allowed — slot: the thing (a dog, a cat)
2. explain who will live in the flat — slot: the person or pet
3. ask whether there are rules about something — slot: the thing (pets, noise)
4. ask whether there is an extra cost for something — slot: the thing (a dog, pet permission)
5. ask whether the landlord needs more information about something — slot: the thing (the dog, pet references)
6. answer whether something is calm or trained — slot: the quality
7. explain how often something would be there alone — slot: the length of time
8. confirm you understand the condition — slot: the condition
must_understand:
1. asks what kind of pet you have and how big it is
2. asks whether the pet is quiet, trained or left alone often
3. says whether pets are allowed and under what conditions
4. explains whether the landlord needs extra information or approval
5. tells you about any extra rules or costs related to pets

TARGET_LANGUAGE: German

NATIVE_LANGUAGE: English

LEVEL: Intermediate

LEARNER_GENDER: unknown

LEARNER_ROLE: Mieter / Tenant

PARTNER_ROLE: Makler / Agent

VOCABULARY_COUNT: 8–12

none

topic.description_target: Sie fragen nach Haustierregeln, Kosten und Genehmigungen und erklären die Situation Ihres Hundes.
topic.description_native: You ask about pet rules, costs, and approvals and explain your dog's situation.

partner_lines.text_target: Welche Art von Haustier haben Sie?
partner_lines.text_native: What kind of pet do you have?

partner_lines.text_target: Ist Ihr Haustier ruhig und gut erzogen?
partner_lines.text_native: Is your pet calm and well trained?

partner_lines.text_target: Ja, Haustiere sind erlaubt, wenn sie die Nachbarn nicht stören.
partner_lines.text_native: Yes, pets are allowed if they do not disturb the neighbours.

partner_lines.text_target: Der Vermieter braucht eine kurze Beschreibung und eine Genehmigung.
partner_lines.text_native: The landlord needs a short description and an approval.

partner_lines.text_target: Für Haustiere fällt keine zusätzliche Gebühr an.
partner_lines.text_native: There is no additional fee for pets.

vocabulary.definition_target: an additional payment
vocabulary.image_prompt: A rental document showing an additional fee

topic.description_target: Nach diesem Tag können Sie nach Haustieren fragen, Ihren Hund erklären und Regeln, Kosten sowie benötigte Informationen verstehen.
topic.description_native: After this day, you can ask about pets, explain your dog, and understand rules, costs, and required information.

slot.hint_native: the pet you want to keep
the person or pet living with you
the thing covered by the rules
the thing that might cost extra

phrases.frame_target: Braucht der Vermieter noch Informationen über ___?
phrases.frame_native: Does the landlord need more information about ___?
phrases.pronunciation_native: browkht dair fair-mee-ter nokh in-for-maht-see-oh-nen oo-ber ___?

slot.hint_native: the subject of the extra information
a quality such as calm or trained
the person or pet that is alone

partner_lines.text_target: Welche Art von Haustier haben Sie?
partner_lines.text_native: What kind of pet do you have?

partner_lines.text_target: Ist Ihr Haustier ruhig und gut erzogen?
partner_lines.text_native: Is your pet calm and well trained?

partner_lines.text_target: Ja. Haustiere sind erlaubt, wenn sie angemeldet sind.
partner_lines.text_native: Yes. Pets are allowed if they are registered.

partner_lines.text_target: Der Vermieter braucht eine kurze Beschreibung und eine Bestätigung der Haftpflichtversicherung.
partner_lines.text_native: The landlord needs a short description and proof of liability insurance.

partner_lines.text_target: Für Haustiere gelten Anmeldepflicht und keine monatlichen Zusatzkosten.
partner_lines.text_native: Pets require registration, but there are no monthly extra costs.

vocabulary.definition_target: to say that something is permitted
vocabulary.image_prompt: A landlord showing a tenant a house rule sign marked as permitted

vocabulary.definition_target: an instruction that must be followed
vocabulary.image_prompt: A printed apartment rule sheet on a table

vocabulary.definition_target: the person who rents out a property
vocabulary.image_prompt: A landlord holding apartment keys during a viewing

vocabulary.definition_target: not making much noise or movement
vocabulary.image_prompt: A calm small dog sitting quietly in a flat

vocabulary.definition_target: to teach an animal good behaviour
vocabulary.image_prompt: A person training a dog to sit indoors

vocabulary.definition_target: without another person or animal present
vocabulary.image_prompt: A dog resting alone in an apartment room

vocabulary.definition_target: to be valid for a person or situation
vocabulary.image_prompt: A tenant reading a notice about apartment conditions

vocabulary.definition_target: to officially record something with the responsible person
vocabulary.image_prompt: A tenant filling out a pet registration form

vocabulary.definition_target: costs added to the usual payment
vocabulary.image_prompt: An apartment cost sheet showing an additional charge line

vocabulary.definition_target: insurance covering damage caused to other people or property
vocabulary.image_prompt: An insurance document beside apartment keys
